remember.description: Number of previous passwords to remember. Set to 0 to disable history.

retry_count.description: Maximum number of password change attempts allowed per session.

file.description: Path to the file storing password history. Must be readable/writable by PAM.

enable_audit.description: If true, enable audit logging of password changes (requires audit support).

root_min_delay.description: Minimum delay (in seconds) enforced between password changes by root. Set to 0 for no delay.

rules.description: List of additional custom configuration rules (key=value pairs).
